items.title: Unagi Puts Persona and Ultimate Champions Up for Sale in Liquidation
items.summary: The sale includes Persona’s intellectual property, a treasury of 957 NFTs and the UNA token contracts, with offers due November 2.

items.title: Coinbase and Marqeta Expand Partnership for Enterprise Stablecoin Cards
items.summary: The planned offering would let businesses fund card programs around the clock, with Coinbase holding balances and Base providing onchain settlement infrastructure.

items.title: Boom or Bust, Bitcoin Wins the AI Trade, Bitwise CIO Says
items.summary: In a note to investors, Matt Hougan used a “Choose Your Own Adventure” framework to argue that superabundance, an AI bust or a muddle-through economy all ultimately funnel to the same place: Bitcoin higher.
